ruledOut: re-litigating Q1-Q4 instead of sequencing from accumulated evidence
using pre-commit, pre-push, or session hooks as the authoritative freshness blocker
removing staging or rollback before closure failures are fixed and lifecycle tests can run
excusing sk-design beyond the narrow inputs-do-not-compile restructure window

summary: Safe-now work begins with dual-location manifest ownership: authored source as reproducibility authority, runtime as byte-equivalent serving mirror, exceptions explicit and temporary.
Safe-now closure repair includes cli-external-orchestration because its sourceInputs omit live registry packet cli-cursor; this is independent of sk-design.
Self-reporting should add exception-aware classified guard output; current guard has reasons and JSON but only global fail or warn-only behavior.
Unattended safety belongs in a sibling CI gate with scoped path filters; local hooks remain warning surfaces.
sk-design work waits because the live registry is four-mode while the compiled child currently requires six modes.
Retain staging/rollback until closure failures are fixed and lifecycle tests can run; prune nested rename recovery only after preserving observable behavior.
